_comment: 리워드 아이템 그림 작업 목록. 이미지 모델에 한 줄씩 넘긴다. 규격과 공통 프롬프트는 brief.md. targetBox는 기리 360 좌표계(viewBox -30 0 360 360)에서 그림이 들어갈 상자 [x1, y1, x2, y2]로, 생성 후 배치할 때 쓴다(reward-flow.md 8.2). 손 아이템의 targetBox는 쥐는 점 (0,0) 기준 아이템 자체 좌표다.

items.prompt: A simple front view of a small Japanese eatery entrance: a dark indigo split noren curtain hanging across the top-left of a wooden doorway, light cream plaster wall, a little potted plant at the bottom-right edge. The center of the picture is a calm, very light, almost empty wall area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.

A single piece of nigiri sushi: an oval white rice block with a salmon slice draped on top, salmon in warm orange with light stripes. Viewed from slightly above, held upright as if pinched at its bottom center.

A simple Japanese train station platform: pale sky, a station name board on two short posts at the top-left, a yellow tactile line along the platform edge at the bottom, a bit of a train window at the right edge. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. Leave the station name board blank with no letters.

A small rectangular Japanese train ticket, cream paper with a thin sky-blue band and a tiny punched hole, standing upright as if held at its bottom edge. No readable text, only two short abstract lines.

A simple Japanese town street: pale sky, low two-story shop buildings on the left and right edges, a utility pole with drooping wires at the top-right, a light paved road. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. No signs with letters.
A small open clear vinyl umbrella, the canopy pale see-through blue-white with dark outline ribs, a wooden curved handle at the bottom. Upright, held by the handle.

A simple shrine approach: a vermilion torii gate framing the picture with its top beam across the top and its two pillars at the left and right edges, a light stone path in the middle, soft green-grey shrubs at the bottom corners, pale sky. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area.
A small Japanese omamori charm: a rounded-top rectangular brocade pouch in vermilion with a simple yellow knot pattern and a looped cord at the top. Upright, held at its bottom. No letters on it.
A cute white festival fox mask (kitsune omen) with simple red-orange markings and a thin cord, shown tilted about 20 degrees as if worn on the upper right side of a head. Only the mask, nothing else.
A festival tasuki sash: a long, narrow indigo cloth band with a thin white edge line, running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a small tied bow at the left end. Only the band.

A twisted cloth headband (nejiri hachimaki) in indigo and white twisted together, shaped as a gentle horizontal arc as if tied around the top of a head, with a small knot and two short tails sticking up at the right side. Only the headband.

A Japanese shop apron (maekake): a thick indigo canvas apron with a plain cream waist band tied across, front view, short and wide. A simple circle emblem with no letters in the middle. Only the apron.

A simple bathhouse entrance: an indigo noren curtain hanging at the top-left, warm wooden frame, a light wooden floor and a pair of small sandals at the bottom-right edge, faint soft steam curls. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.
A small folded tenugui hand towel, white with a simple indigo wave pattern, folded into a neat flat rectangle and resting slightly tilted, as if placed on top of a head. Only the towel.

A furoshiki wrapping cloth in purple with a simple light arabesque swirl pattern, worn like a neckerchief: a band running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a bunny-ear knot at the left end. Only the cloth.
A slice of dark red-brown yokan (sweet bean jelly) block on a small wooden plate, a little bamboo pick stuck in it. Upright, held by the bottom of the plate.
